name: incline push-up on box
description: A push-up with the hands on a sturdy box. The elevated hands reduce the load while the chest and triceps press the body up.
instructions: Place your hands on a sturdy box slightly wider than shoulder-width and step your feet back.
Keep your body straight from head to heels as you bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the box.
Press through your hands to return to straight arms without letting your hips sag.
